grooves.name: Delta shuffle
grooves.text: A loping blues shuffle on brushes and a dry snare.

grooves.name: Big band swing
grooves.text: Ride spang-a-lang, feathered kick on every beat, hat on two and four.

grooves.name: Bebop
grooves.text: Fast ride, the left hand and kick dropping bombs.

grooves.name: Chicago blues
grooves.text: Electric blues backbeat with a swung hat.

grooves.name: Cool jazz
grooves.text: Brushes swirling, a soft and spacious ride.

grooves.name: Hard bop
grooves.text: Bluesier, harder: a driving ride and snare comping.

grooves.name: Bossa nova
grooves.text: Cross-stick clave over a soft surdo kick.

grooves.name: Modal jazz
grooves.text: A floating ride, two and four on the hat.

grooves.name: Soul jazz
grooves.text: Organ-trio groove: a funky shuffle with a backbeat.

grooves.name: Jazz fusion
grooves.text: Busy sixteenths, ghosts and syncopated kicks.

grooves.name: Acid jazz
grooves.text: Funky break, a jazzy ride on top.

grooves.name: Nu jazz
grooves.text: Broken-beat shuffle, chopped and modern.

grooves.name: Jump blues
grooves.text: Shuffling backbeat that started to rock.

grooves.name: Doo-wop

grooves.name: Motown
grooves.text: Four on the snare, tambourine on top, kick on the beat.

grooves.name: Southern soul
grooves.text: A fat, laid-back backbeat with a sizzling hat.

grooves.name: Funk
grooves.text: On the one: ghost-note snare and a busy kick.

grooves.name: Philly soul
grooves.text: Smooth and lush: open hats on the offbeat.

grooves.name: Disco
grooves.text: Four on the floor, the open hat between.

grooves.name: Go-go
grooves.text: Washington swing: congas, cowbell and a lazy pocket.

grooves.name: Boogie
grooves.text: Post-disco: a drum machine with funky claps.

grooves.name: New jack swing
grooves.text: Swung sixteenths, hard snare, sampled stabs.

grooves.name: Neo soul
grooves.text: Drunk, behind-the-beat, warm and crunchy.

grooves.name: Rock and roll
grooves.text: Shuffled eighths and a slapping snare.

grooves.name: Rockabilly
grooves.text: Train beat on the snare, upright slap feel.

grooves.name: Surf rock
grooves.text: Galloping toms and a crashing ride.

grooves.name: British beat
grooves.text: Eighths on the hat, a bright snare, the kick with the bass.

grooves.name: Garage rock
grooves.text: Trashy ride, simple and loud.

grooves.name: Psychedelic rock
grooves.text: Tom-heavy, loose, a hypnotic floor tom.

grooves.name: Hard rock
grooves.text: Big room, quarter-note hat, a heavy backbeat.

grooves.name: Progressive rock
grooves.text: Odd accents across the bar, toms in the gaps.

grooves.name: Glam rock
grooves.text: Stomping toms and handclaps.

grooves.name: Punk
grooves.text: Eighths on everything, fast and raw.

grooves.name: Post-punk
grooves.text: Tom-driven, cold and danceable.

grooves.name: New wave
grooves.text: Tight sixteenth hats, a gated snare.

grooves.name: Indie rock
grooves.text: Floor-tom pulse and a jangly ride.

grooves.name: Grunge
grooves.text: Huge, sloppy, a heavy kick and open hats.

grooves.name: Britpop
grooves.text: Bouncy, a tambourine and a swaggering snare.

grooves.name: Pop punk
grooves.text: Fast eighths on the ride, punky and bright.

grooves.name: Post-rock
grooves.text: A slow build of toms and swelling cymbals.

grooves.name: Emo
grooves.text: Driving crash-ride, tom fills into the chorus.

grooves.name: Garage revival
grooves.text: Disco-punk hats over a straight beat.

grooves.name: Math rock
grooves.text: Odd groupings, the snare where you do not expect it.

grooves.name: Heavy metal
grooves.text: Doomy and heavy: the first riffs got a drummer like this.

grooves.name: NWOBHM
grooves.text: Galloping kick under a fast ride.

grooves.name: Doom metal
grooves.text: Crushingly slow, the crash ringing out.

grooves.name: Thrash metal
grooves.text: The thrash beat: kick and snare alternating, fast.

grooves.name: Speed metal
grooves.text: Even faster: double kick sixteenths under the ride.

grooves.name: Power metal
grooves.text: Double-kick gallop and an anthemic snare.

grooves.name: Death metal

grooves.name: Black metal
grooves.text: Tremolo blasts: snare and kick alternating, cymbals washing.

grooves.name: Groove metal
grooves.text: Mid-tempo, syncopated kicks locked with the riff.

grooves.name: Industrial metal
grooves.text: Machine-tight, quantised and pounding.

grooves.name: Progressive metal
grooves.text: Odd meters inside four: shifting kick patterns.

grooves.name: Nu metal
grooves.text: Hip-hop pocket under detuned riffs.

grooves.name: Symphonic metal
grooves.text: Epic double kick under orchestral hits.

grooves.name: Metalcore
grooves.text: Breakdown: half-time crashes and kick stabs.

grooves.name: Sludge & post-metal
grooves.text: Slow, swinging, enormous.

grooves.name: Deathcore
grooves.text: Blasts that fall into slam breakdowns.

grooves.name: Djent
grooves.text: Polyrhythmic kicks locked to palm-muted riffs, the snare steady.

grooves.name: Blackgaze
grooves.text: Blast beats under shimmering walls.

grooves.name: Old school

grooves.name: Electro

grooves.name: Boom bap

grooves.name: Jazz rap
grooves.text: Swinging brushes behind a laid-back flow.

grooves.name: G-funk
grooves.text: Laid-back West Coast bounce, handclaps.

grooves.name: East Coast

grooves.name: Crunk
grooves.text: Huge 808s and claps for the club.

grooves.name: Trap
grooves.text: Hat rolls, half-time snare, sliding 808.

grooves.name: Cloud rap
grooves.text: Hazy half-time beat, sparse and wide.

grooves.name: Drill
grooves.text: Sliding 808, snare on the third beat, skipping hats.

grooves.name: Lo-fi hip-hop
grooves.text: Dusty, swung, mellow.

grooves.name: Phonk
grooves.text: Cowbell melodies over a distorted 808.

grooves.name: Rage
grooves.text: Hyper hats and blown-out 808s.

grooves.name: Jersey club
grooves.text: Triplet kicks and bed squeaks.

grooves.name: Synth-pop
grooves.text: Drum machine pulse, tight and bright.

grooves.name: Hi-NRG
grooves.text: Fast four on the floor with offbeat hats.

grooves.name: Chicago house
grooves.text: Four on the floor, claps on two and four.

grooves.name: Detroit techno
grooves.text: Machine soul: driving hats and a hollow clap.

grooves.name: Acid house
grooves.text: Bare four on the floor for the squelch to ride.

grooves.name: Deep house
grooves.text: Warm, shuffled hats and a soft rim.

grooves.name: Trance
grooves.text: Driving kick, offbeat open hat, snare rolls into the drop.

grooves.name: Jungle
grooves.text: Chopped breakbeat at double speed, a rolling sub.

grooves.name: Drum & bass
grooves.text: Two-step break: kick on one, snare on two and four.

grooves.name: Big beat
grooves.text: Distorted breaks for a big tent.

grooves.name: UK garage
grooves.text: Two-step: skipping kicks, shuffled hats.

grooves.name: Hardstyle
grooves.text: Distorted reverse-bass kick on every beat.

grooves.name: Minimal techno
grooves.text: Clicks and rims, space between.

grooves.name: Dubstep
grooves.text: Half-time snare on three, a sub that wobbles.

grooves.name: Electro house
grooves.text: Big claps, side-chained everything.

grooves.name: Footwork
grooves.text: Triplet kicks and stuttered claps.

grooves.name: Synthwave
grooves.text: Gated 80s snare on a nostalgic beat.

grooves.name: Future bass
grooves.text: Half-time with a huge snare and chopped chords.

grooves.name: Afro house
grooves.text: Four on the floor wrapped in percussion.

grooves.name: Hyperpop
grooves.text: Clipped, glitchy and maximal.

grooves.name: Samba
grooves.text: Surdo, shaker and a busy rim.

grooves.name: Mambo
grooves.text: Cowbell on the beat, congas tumbao.

grooves.name: Cumbia
grooves.text: Shaker on every sixteenth, a lilting kick.

grooves.name: Ska
grooves.text: Offbeats everywhere, a skanking hat.

grooves.name: Rocksteady
grooves.text: Slower ska, cross-stick on the third beat.

grooves.name: Salsa
grooves.text: Clave, cascara and conga tumbao.

grooves.name: Afrobeat
grooves.text: Interlocking hats, toms and a long groove.

grooves.name: Reggae one drop
grooves.text: Kick and rim together on three, nothing on one.

grooves.name: Dancehall
grooves.text: Riddim: kick on the beat, a clattering snare.

grooves.name: Reggaeton
grooves.text: Dembow: boom, ch-boom-chick.

grooves.name: Baile funk
grooves.text: Tamborzão: a rattling Miami-bass rhythm.

grooves.name: Afrobeats
grooves.text: Light and bouncy: shaker, rim and a skipping kick.

grooves.name: Amapiano
grooves.text: Log drums, shakers, an off-kilter kick.

grooves.name: 50s pop ballad

grooves.name: Girl group
grooves.text: The famous intro: boom, boom-boom, crack.

grooves.name: Disco pop
grooves.text: Four on the floor for the radio.

grooves.name: Power ballad
grooves.text: A slow, huge snare in a cathedral.

grooves.name: Teen pop
grooves.text: Polished, syncopated and shiny.

grooves.name: Dance pop
grooves.text: Club kick and claps under a big hook.

grooves.name: Stomp pop
grooves.text: Stomps and claps on the floor.

grooves.name: Bedroom pop
grooves.text: Soft and close, a lazy pocket.

grooves.name: K-pop
grooves.text: Many sections in one: trap hats into a four-on-the-floor.
